Traits Signal

The first Encore spent by any ally each round costs nothing: the ally gains the full benefit and your pool is not reduced. This does not add a spend — it is still the round's shared spend, and it is still limited by however many spends per round your allies are entitled to.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (there is no pool to not-decrement) and SB2 (the spend itself is a reroll grant). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
